summary:
Issue #1003: establish the labeled mathematical cardinality claim and R1–R3 controls; the attempted inference to no infinite causal regress fails as a discriminator. Distinct transported omega orders are counted, not duplicate encodings or unlabeled types. Fixed endpoint plus all links determine the order; binary-vector abundance can accompany an empty well-founded dependency relation; finite induction reconstructs an infinite enumeration from a seed and rule. Constant evidence fails selection; complete endpoint/link facts pass the same test without thereby being explanatory. Rejected: cardinality as a quantity of unexplainedness, identical fixed links with independently permuted order, and the claim that infinite cases require infinite separate checking. The selection requirement and the nonselecting-explanation rival are explicit OPEN siblings. No new source claim or attribution to Leibniz, and no root-premise defense. Exact proof/interpretation boundaries are in docs/notes/ordering-cardinality-1003.md. A separate closed successor-recursion certificate verifies all values by finite induction without a universal test-outcome hypothesis. Verification: all three focused result builds pass; scoped binding reports 3 bound and 0 mismatches; Comparator and independent NanoDa accept all three frozen Challenges. Axiom probes match the permitted Mathlib policy (cardinality and controls use propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound; finite-rule verification uses Quot.sound). Claim/type self-sweep preserves labeled-order scope, the fixed endpoint, abstract Unit omission, conditional reconstruction and the separate closed rule example; no target-causal-WF or adequacy claim follows. Computed frontier-diff against current main reports 90 open premises (30 bare, 18 supported, 42 stated), cheapest route 31, no change. Review P1 discussion_r4484741767 identified a faulty initial rival encoding: negating Selects admitted failure of actual truth, including a judgment accepting only constant false. Corrected the existing open rival to require actual truth and an explicit distinct compatible arrangement; rejected the broader false-candidate reading. The truthful-rival control excludes actual-false candidates, conditionally supplies a true nonselecting witness without asserting its real adequacy, and proves incompatibility with the selection requirement. Existing frozen Challenges and result types are untouched. Repair verification: affected Solution modules rebuilt; truthful-rival binding reports 1 bound and 0 mismatches; Comparator/NanoDa and the allowed-three-axiom probe pass. Original three certified theorem types and frozen Challenges remain unchanged and their earlier formal evidence is reused. Final delivered-head CI covers the integration.

Definition/coverage follow-up: reused the existing TruthfulRival.checks theorem, whose false-only control already shows why the truthful rival is not the exact complement of generic CompleteRequiresSelection. Introduced independent AcceptedAreTrue factivity and concrete AcceptedFalse countercase, sole-premise selection→factivity strength, exact matching selection/factivity negatives and their actual counterexample consequences. Explicit EM covers complete selection OR truthful nonselection OR false acceptance (coverage only, negative branches may overlap). The ordinary two-way fork now carries factivity as a visible input. Reused old permutation/control mathematics; false-only and true-only judgments test the gap and strictness, while a nonempty selection-defined positive calibration is explicitly analytic and no independent explanatory warrant. No source attribution, old Challenge, ordering/cardinality semantics or philosophical premise truth changed. Seven checked configurations, exact boundaries in docs/notes/selection-factivity-coverage.md.
blocker: Deriving the existing real causal WF premise still needs independently defended arrangement-explanation relevance, actual causal admissibility, rejection of nonnecessitating/intrinsic rivals, and a further bridge from explanatory demand to impossible infinite regress. A demand for explanation alone is not nonexistence. The existing supported target remains open.
